id-20260912-news-2.title: Indonesia's Palm Oil Exports to the EU Held Back by the Shadow of EUDR, Far Behind China

segments.src: Industri kelapa sawit nasional kembali dihadapkan pada tantangan besar di pasar ekspor utama.
segments.tr: The national palm oil industry is once again facing major challenges in key export markets.

segments.src: Volume pengiriman minyak sawit mentah atau crude palm oil (CPO) Indonesia ke Uni Eropa tercatat tertahan di kisaran 3,2 juta ton, jauh tertinggal dibandingkan volume ekspor ke China yang mencapai 5,9 juta ton.
segments.tr: Indonesia's shipments of crude palm oil (CPO) to the European Union have been recorded to stall at around 3.2 million tons, falling far behind export volumes to China, which reached 5.9 million tons.

segments.src: Kesenjangan ini mencerminkan pergeseran arah perdagangan sawit nasional seiring meningkatnya tekanan regulasi di pasar Eropa.
segments.tr: This gap reflects a shift in the direction of national palm oil trade alongside increasing regulatory pressure in the European market.

segments.src: ## Bayang-Bayang Regulasi Antideforestasi Uni Eropa
segments.tr: ## The Shadow of the European Union Deforestation Regulation

segments.src: Salah satu faktor yang banyak disorot pelaku usaha adalah rencana penerapan penuh European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR), regulasi yang mewajibkan produk pertanian termasuk sawit untuk dibuktikan bebas dari praktik deforestasi sejak akhir 2020.
segments.tr: One of the factors heavily highlighted by business players is the planned full implementation of the European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR), a regulation requiring agricultural products including palm oil to be proven free from deforestation practices since late 2020.

segments.src: Aturan ini menuntut sistem keterlacakan (traceability) yang detail hingga ke titik koordinat lahan, sesuatu yang dinilai berat khususnya bagi petani sawit swadaya yang mengelola lahan dalam skala kecil dan tersebar.
segments.tr: This rule demands a detailed traceability system down to land coordinate points, something considered burdensome, especially for independent smallholder palm oil farmers who manage small-scale and scattered plots.

segments.src: Ketidakpastian soal jadwal serta mekanisme teknis pelaksanaan EUDR membuat sebagian eksportir dan pembeli di Eropa bersikap lebih hati-hati dalam menjalin kontrak jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Uncertainty regarding the schedule and technical implementation mechanism of the EUDR has caused some exporters and buyers in Europe to be more cautious in establishing long-term contracts.

segments.src: Kondisi ini turut mendorong pelaku industri mengalihkan sebagian volume penjualan ke pasar alternatif yang dinilai memiliki persyaratan lebih fleksibel, salah satunya China.
segments.tr: This condition has also prompted industry players to divert some sales volumes to alternative markets deemed to have more flexible requirements, one of which is China.

segments.src: ## China Jadi Tujuan Ekspor Andalan
segments.tr: ## China Becomes a Mainstay Export Destination

segments.src: Berbeda dengan Uni Eropa, permintaan dari China terhadap CPO Indonesia relatif stabil dan cenderung meningkat.
segments.tr: Unlike the European Union, demand from China for Indonesia's CPO is relatively stable and tends to increase.

segments.src: Kebutuhan minyak nabati untuk konsumsi pangan maupun industri di China menjadi salah satu pendorong utama tingginya volume serapan tersebut.
segments.tr: The need for vegetable oil for both food consumption and industrial use in China is one of the main drivers of this high absorption volume.

segments.src: Selisih hampir dua kali lipat antara ekspor ke China dan Uni Eropa ini menegaskan bahwa peta permintaan global terhadap sawit Indonesia tengah bergeser dari pasar tradisional Barat menuju kawasan Asia.
segments.tr: The nearly twofold difference between exports to China and the European Union emphasizes that the global demand map for Indonesian palm oil is shifting from traditional Western markets toward the Asian region.

segments.src: ## Percepatan Sertifikasi ISPO dan Penguatan Rantai Pasok
segments.tr: ## Acceleration of ISPO Certification and Supply Chain Strengthening

segments.src: Menghadapi tantangan tersebut, pelaku industri sawit dalam negeri disebut tengah mempercepat proses sertifikasi Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO) sekaligus memperkuat sistem keterlacakan rantai pasok dari kebun hingga pabrik pengolahan.
segments.tr: Facing these challenges, domestic palm oil industry players are reportedly accelerating the Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO) certification process while strengthening supply chain traceability systems from plantations to processing mills.

segments.src: Langkah ini dipandang penting bukan hanya untuk memenuhi standar keberlanjutan yang diminta pasar Eropa, tetapi juga untuk menjaga daya saing sawit nasional di tengah ketatnya persaingan minyak nabati global.
segments.tr: This step is seen as important not only to meet the sustainability standards demanded by the European market, but also to maintain the competitiveness of national palm oil amid tight global vegetable oil competition.

segments.src: Beberapa asosiasi dan pemangku kepentingan di sektor sawit juga mendorong digitalisasi data perkebunan, termasuk pemetaan lahan berbasis geospasial, agar proses verifikasi kepatuhan terhadap EUDR dapat berjalan lebih efisien.
segments.tr: Several associations and stakeholders in the palm oil sector are also encouraging the digitalization of plantation data, including geospatial-based land mapping, so that the verification process for EUDR compliance can run more efficiently.

segments.src: Dukungan terhadap petani swadaya melalui program legalitas lahan dan pendampingan teknis turut menjadi perhatian, mengingat kelompok ini menyumbang porsi signifikan dari total produksi sawit nasional.
segments.tr: Support for independent smallholders through land legality programs and technical assistance is also a point of attention, given that this group accounts for a significant portion of total national palm oil production.

segments.src: ## Tantangan sekaligus Peluang ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Challenges as Well as Future Opportunities

segments.src: Meski volume ekspor ke Uni Eropa belum kembali ke level sebelumnya, sejumlah pelaku usaha meyakini bahwa penguatan tata kelola dan sertifikasi justru dapat menjadi modal penting bagi keberlanjutan industri sawit dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Although export volumes to the European Union have not returned to previous levels, a number of business players believe that strengthening governance and certification can actually be an important asset for the long-term sustainability of the palm oil industry.

segments.src: Kepatuhan terhadap standar internasional dinilai dapat membuka akses ke pasar-pasar baru yang juga mulai menerapkan persyaratan keberlanjutan serupa.
segments.tr: Compliance with international standards is considered capable of opening access to new markets that are also beginning to implement similar sustainability requirements.

segments.src: Ke depan, arah kebijakan pemerintah dan respons pelaku industri terhadap pemberlakuan penuh EUDR akan menjadi penentu apakah pangsa pasar sawit Indonesia di Uni Eropa dapat kembali pulih, atau justru semakin bergantung pada permintaan dari mitra dagang Asia seperti China.
segments.tr: Going forward, the direction of government policy and the response of industry players to the full enforcement of the EUDR will determine whether Indonesia's palm oil market share in the European Union can recover, or instead become increasingly dependent on demand from Asian trading partners such as China.

id-20260912-news-3.title: Cooking Oil and Granulated Sugar Prices Drop Together in Early September, Government Continues to Monitor HET

segments.src: Memasuki awal September, harga dua komoditas pangan strategis yakni minyak goreng curah dan gula pasir lokal menunjukkan tren penurunan di sejumlah pasar tradisional.
segments.tr: Entering early September, the prices of two strategic food commodities, namely bulk cooking oil and local granulated sugar, have shown a downward trend in a number of traditional markets.

segments.src: Kondisi ini disambut positif oleh masyarakat, terutama menjelang aktivitas ekonomi rumah tangga yang kembali normal setelah periode permintaan tinggi beberapa waktu sebelumnya.
segments.tr: This condition is welcomed positively by the community, especially ahead of household economic activities that are returning to normal after a period of high demand some time ago.

segments.src: ## Rincian Penurunan Harga
segments.tr: ## Price Drop Details

segments.src: Berdasarkan pemantauan harga di pasar, minyak goreng curah tercatat turun dari sebelumnya sekitar Rp21.250 per kilogram menjadi kisaran Rp20.450 per kilogram.
segments.tr: Based on price monitoring in the market, bulk cooking oil was recorded to have dropped from around Rp21.250 per kilogram to a range of Rp20.450 per kilogram.

segments.src: Sementara itu, harga gula pasir lokal juga melandai ke level sekitar Rp19.100 per kilogram.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, the price of local granulated sugar also eased to a level of around Rp19.100 per kilogram.

segments.src: Penurunan harga kedua komoditas ini diperkirakan dipengaruhi oleh sejumlah faktor, termasuk pasokan yang lebih stabil di tingkat distributor serta membaiknya arus distribusi dari sentra produksi ke pasar-pasar daerah.
segments.tr: The price decline of these two commodities is estimated to be influenced by a number of factors, including more stable supply at the distributor level and improved distribution flow from production centers to regional markets.

segments.src: Meski demikian, sejumlah pedagang menyebut harga masih dapat berfluktuasi mengikuti dinamika pasokan bahan baku dan biaya distribusi.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, a number of traders mentioned that prices could still fluctuate following the dynamics of raw material supply and distribution costs.

segments.src: ## Pemerintah Tegaskan Pengawasan HET
segments.tr: ## Government Emphasizes HET Supervision

segments.src: Di tengah tren penurunan harga ini, Kementerian Pertanian menegaskan bahwa pengawasan terhadap Harga Eceran Tertinggi (HET) tetap menjadi prioritas.
segments.tr: Amid this downward price trend, the Ministry of Agriculture emphasized that supervision of the Highest Retail Price (HET) remains a priority.

segments.src: Pemerintah menyatakan akan menindak tegas pelaku usaha atau pedagang yang terbukti menjual komoditas pangan di atas ketentuan HET yang berlaku.
segments.tr: The government stated that it will take firm action against business actors or traders proven to be selling food commodities above the applicable HET provisions.

segments.src: Langkah pengawasan ini dilakukan untuk memastikan penurunan harga yang terjadi benar-benar dirasakan oleh konsumen akhir, bukan hanya berhenti di tingkat distributor besar.
segments.tr: This supervision step is taken to ensure that the price decline that is occurring is truly felt by end consumers, not just stopping at the large distributor level.

segments.src: Instansi terkait juga disebut akan terus melakukan pemantauan berkala di pasar-pasar tradisional maupun modern guna menjaga kestabilan harga menjelang periode-periode permintaan tinggi berikutnya.
segments.tr: Relevant agencies are also said to continue conducting periodic monitoring in traditional and modern markets to maintain price stability ahead of the next high-demand periods.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi Konsumen dan Pelaku Usaha
segments.tr: ## Impact on Consumers and Business Actors

segments.src: Penurunan harga minyak goreng dan gula pasir tentu memberi sedikit ruang bernapas bagi rumah tangga, khususnya pelaku usaha kecil di sektor kuliner yang sangat bergantung pada kedua bahan pokok tersebut.
segments.tr: The decline in cooking oil and granulated sugar prices certainly provides a little breathing room for households, especially small business actors in the culinary sector who are highly dependent on these two staple foods.

segments.src: Namun, para pengamat ekonomi mengingatkan bahwa stabilitas harga jangka panjang tetap bergantung pada kelancaran rantai pasok, ketersediaan bahan baku, serta kebijakan harga acuan yang konsisten dari pemerintah.
segments.tr: However, economic observers remind that long-term price stability still depends on the smoothness of the supply chain, the availability of raw materials, and consistent reference price policies from the government.

segments.src: Masyarakat diimbau untuk terus memantau perkembangan harga melalui kanal resmi pemerintah daerah maupun kementerian terkait, sekaligus melaporkan apabila menemukan indikasi penjualan di atas HET di lapangan.
segments.tr: The public is urged to continue monitoring price developments through official channels of local governments or relevant ministries, as well as to report if they find indications of sales above the HET in the field.

segments.src: Dengan pengawasan yang konsisten, diharapkan tren positif penurunan harga ini dapat bertahan dan memberi manfaat nyata bagi daya beli masyarakat.
segments.tr: With consistent supervision, it is hoped that this positive trend of price decline can be maintained and provide real benefits for people's purchasing power.

id-20260912-intro-marketing-9.title: [Marketing #9] Why Do Good Products Often Lose to Products That Are Simply "Easier to Buy"?

segments.src: > Produk hebat yang tidak ada di tempat dan waktu pelanggan ingin membeli sama saja dengan produk yang tidak ada — itulah inti dari Place, huruf ketiga dalam bauran pemasaran 4P.
segments.tr: > A great product that is not where and when the customer wants to buy it is just like a product that does not exist — that is the essence of Place, the third P in the 4P marketing mix.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Dalam bauran pemasaran (marketing mix) ada empat elemen: Product, Price, Place, dan Promotion.
segments.tr: In the marketing mix, there are four elements: Product, Price, Place, and Promotion.

segments.src: Setelah pekan lalu kita membahas harga, kini giliran **Place** — atau lebih tepat disebut **distribusi**: bagaimana produk berpindah dari pabrik/dapur produsen sampai ke tangan pembeli.
segments.tr: After discussing price last week, now it is time for **Place** — or more accurately called **distribution**: how a product moves from the manufacturer's factory/kitchen into the hands of the buyer.

segments.src: Banyak orang mengira "Place" berarti lokasi toko.
segments.tr: Many people think "Place" means store location.

segments.src: Sebenarnya cakupannya lebih luas: **saluran distribusi (distribution channel)**, yaitu rangkaian pihak yang terlibat agar produk tersedia untuk dikonsumsi.
segments.tr: Actually, the scope is broader: **distribution channel**, which is the network of parties involved to make products available for consumption.

segments.src: Kita biasa membedakannya berdasarkan berapa banyak **perantara (intermediary)** yang ada di tengah:
segments.tr: We usually distinguish them based on how many **intermediaries** are in the middle:

segments.src: - **Saluran langsung (nol tingkat):** produsen → konsumen. Contoh: petani kopi yang menjual sendiri lewat Instagram, atau brand yang punya toko resmi sendiri.
segments.tr: - **Direct channel (zero-level):** producer → consumer. Example: a coffee farmer selling directly via Instagram, or a brand with its own official store.

segments.src: - **Satu tingkat:** produsen → pengecer (retailer) → konsumen.
segments.tr: - **One-level:** producer → retailer → consumer.

segments.src: - **Dua tingkat atau lebih:** produsen → distributor → grosir/agen → warung/toko → konsumen.
segments.tr: - **Two levels or more:** producer → distributor → wholesaler/agent → stall/store → consumer.

segments.src: Pertanyaan yang wajar muncul: kalau perantara mengambil margin, kenapa tidak dipotong saja semuanya?
segments.tr: A natural question arises: if intermediaries take a margin, why not cut them all out?

segments.src: Karena perantara sebenarnya **mengurangi total biaya transaksi**.
segments.tr: Because intermediaries actually **reduce total transaction costs**.

segments.src: Bayangkan 3 produsen makanan ringan yang ingin masuk ke 5 warung.
segments.tr: Imagine 3 snack producers who want to enter 5 stalls.

segments.src: Kalau masing-masing berhubungan langsung:
segments.tr: If each deals directly:

segments.src: 3 produsen × 5 warung = 15 jalur kontak
segments.tr: 3 produsen × 5 warung = 15 jalur kontak

segments.src: Kalau ada satu distributor di tengah:
segments.tr: If there is one distributor in the middle:

segments.src: 3 + 5 = 8 jalur kontak
segments.tr: 3 + 5 = 8 jalur kontak

segments.src: Semakin banyak pemainnya, penghematannya makin besar.
segments.tr: The more players there are, the greater the savings.

segments.src: Selain itu perantara melakukan pekerjaan yang tidak terlihat konsumen: memecah kiriman besar menjadi satuan kecil (*breaking bulk*), menyediakan variasi barang dalam satu tempat, menanggung stok dan risiko, memberi tempo pembayaran, sampai mengumpulkan informasi pasar.
segments.tr: In addition, intermediaries do work that is invisible to consumers: breaking large shipments into small units (*breaking bulk*), providing product variety in one place, bearing stock and risk, providing payment terms, and gathering market information.

segments.src: Menghapus perantara tidak menghapus pekerjaannya — pekerjaan itu hanya berpindah ke pundak produsen.
segments.tr: Removing intermediaries does not remove the work — that work simply shifts to the producer's shoulders.

segments.src: Keputusan penting kedua adalah **intensitas distribusi**:
segments.tr: The second important decision is **distribution intensity**:

segments.src: - **Distribusi intensif** — masuk ke sebanyak mungkin titik jual. Cocok untuk barang kebutuhan sehari-hari seperti air mineral, rokok, atau mi instan, di mana konsumen tidak mau repot mencari.
segments.tr: - **Intensive distribution** — entering as many sales points as possible. Suitable for everyday goods like mineral water, cigarettes, or instant noodles, where consumers do not want to bother searching.

segments.src: - **Distribusi selektif** — hanya beberapa penyalur terpilih per wilayah. Umum untuk elektronik atau kosmetik, agar layanan dan citra merek tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: - **Selective distribution** — only a few chosen outlets per region. Common for electronics or cosmetics, to maintain service and brand image.

segments.src: - **Distribusi eksklusif** — satu penyalur resmi saja di suatu area. Dipakai mobil mewah atau jam tangan premium.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive distribution** — only one official dealer in a given area. Used for luxury cars or premium watches.

segments.src: Keputusan ketiga, yang paling relevan hari ini: **omnichannel**.
segments.tr: The third decision, most relevant today: **omnichannel**.

segments.src: Perlu dibedakan dari *multichannel*.
segments.tr: It needs to be distinguished from *multichannel*.

segments.src: Multichannel berarti sebuah brand punya banyak kanal — toko fisik, marketplace, aplikasi sendiri — tetapi jalan sendiri-sendiri: stok terpisah, harga bisa beda, poin membernya tidak nyambung.
segments.tr: Multichannel means a brand has many channels — physical stores, marketplaces, own apps — but they run independently: separate inventory, different prices, member points do not connect.

segments.src: Omnichannel berarti kanal-kanal itu **terhubung menjadi satu pengalaman**: satu data pelanggan, satu catatan stok, sehingga pembeli bisa memesan lewat aplikasi dan mengambil di toko, atau menukar barang yang dibeli online di gerai offline.
segments.tr: Omnichannel means those channels are **connected into a single experience**: one customer data record, one inventory record, so buyers can order via app and pick up in store, or exchange items bought online at offline outlets.

segments.src: Terakhir, ada **konflik saluran (channel conflict)**: ketika brand menjual langsung dengan harga lebih murah di marketplace-nya sendiri, reseller yang selama ini menjaga pasar merasa dirugikan.
segments.tr: Lastly, there is **channel conflict**: when a brand sells directly at a cheaper price on its own marketplace, resellers who previously guarded the market feel disadvantaged.

segments.src: Ini masalah nyata yang harus dikelola, bukan diabaikan.
segments.tr: This is a real problem that must be managed, not ignored.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Kopi Nusa, brand kopi susu botolan dari Bandung dengan harga Rp18.000 per botol.
segments.tr: Imagine Kopi Nusa, a bottled milk coffee brand from Bandung priced at Rp18.000 per bottle.

segments.src: **Tahap 1 — langsung.** Awalnya mereka hanya jualan di satu kios dekat kampus dan lewat DM Instagram, diantar sendiri pakai motor.
segments.tr: **Stage 1 — direct.** Initially they only sold at one kiosk near campus and via Instagram DM, delivered themselves by motorcycle.

segments.src: Margin per botol besar karena tidak ada perantara, tapi sehari maksimal 120 botol.
segments.tr: The margin per bottle was large because there were no intermediaries, but a maximum of 120 bottles per day.

segments.src: Jangkauannya mentok di radius beberapa kilometer.
segments.tr: The reach was capped at a radius of a few kilometers.

segments.src: **Tahap 2 — pakai perantara.** Mereka menunjuk **agen** di Bandung dan Jakarta.
segments.tr: **Stage 2 — using intermediaries.** They appointed **agents** in Bandung and Jakarta.

segments.src: Agen membeli putus 500 botol sekaligus, menyimpannya di gudang pendingin, lalu menyalurkan ke warung, kantin sekolah, dan kafe kecil.
segments.tr: Agents bought 500 bottles outright at once, stored them in cold storage, and then distributed them to stalls, school canteens, and small cafes.

segments.src: Harga jual ke agen jadi Rp11.000 — margin per botol turun, tetapi volume melompat ke ribuan botol per minggu dan penagihan ke ratusan warung bukan lagi urusan Kopi Nusa.
segments.tr: The selling price to agents became Rp11.000 — the margin per bottle dropped, but volume jumped to thousands of bottles per week and collecting payments from hundreds of stalls was no longer Kopi Nusa's problem.

segments.src: Inilah *trade-off* klasik distribusi: **margin ditukar dengan jangkauan**.
segments.tr: This is the classic distribution *trade-off*: **margin traded for reach**.

segments.src: **Tahap 3 — masuk ritel modern.** Kopi Nusa lolos masuk jaringan minimarket.
segments.tr: **Stage 3 — entering modern retail.** Kopi Nusa successfully entered minimarket chains.

segments.src: Konsekuensinya: ada biaya masuk rak (*listing fee*), target rotasi penjualan, dan kewajiban memasok ratusan gerai secara konsisten.
segments.tr: The consequence: there are shelf-entry fees (*listing fee*), sales rotation targets, and the obligation to supply hundreds of outlets consistently.

segments.src: Kalau stok kosong tiga hari, rak itu bisa diambil merek lain.
segments.tr: If stock runs out for three days, that shelf can be taken by another brand.

segments.src: Distribusi intensif menuntut kemampuan pasok yang intensif pula.
segments.tr: Intensive distribution demands intensive supply capabilities as well.

segments.src: **Tahap 4 — omnichannel.** Sekarang pelanggan bisa membeli Kopi Nusa lewat marketplace, lewat aplikasi pesan-antar, atau langsung di kafe mereka.
segments.tr: **Stage 4 — omnichannel.** Now customers can buy Kopi Nusa through marketplaces, delivery apps, or directly at their cafe.

segments.src: Yang membuatnya omnichannel bukan banyaknya kanal, melainkan penyatuannya: pesan lewat aplikasi lalu ambil di gerai, poin member dari pembelian online tetap bisa dipakai di gerai offline, dan tim tahu persis sisa stok tiap gerai sehingga pesanan online bisa dikirim dari gerai terdekat — bukan dari gudang pusat.
segments.tr: What makes it omnichannel is not the number of channels, but their integration: order via app then pick up at the outlet, member points from online purchases can still be used at offline outlets, and the team knows the exact remaining stock of each outlet so online orders can be sent from the nearest outlet — not from the central warehouse.

segments.src: Ongkos **last-mile** turun, waktu antar ikut turun.
segments.tr: **Last-mile** costs drop, delivery times drop as well.

segments.src: Perhatikan bahwa rasa kopinya tidak berubah sejak tahap 1.
segments.tr: Note that the coffee taste has not changed since stage 1.

segments.src: Yang berubah hanyalah seberapa mudah orang mendapatkannya — dan itu yang menentukan omzet.
segments.tr: What changed is simply how easy it is for people to get it — and that determines turnover.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. **Place** adalah keputusan tentang saluran distribusi: bagaimana produk sampai ke pembeli, bukan sekadar di mana tokonya berdiri.
segments.tr: 1. **Place** is a decision about distribution channels: how products reach buyers, not just where the store stands.

segments.src: 2. **Perantara memang mengambil margin, tetapi mereka menekan jumlah kontak transaksi** dan menanggung stok, risiko, serta penyaluran — sehingga produsen menukar margin dengan jangkauan.
segments.tr: 2. **Intermediaries do take a margin, but they reduce the number of transaction contacts** and bear stock, risk, and distribution — so producers trade margin for reach.

segments.src: 3. **Intensitas distribusi (intensif/selektif/eksklusif) harus cocok dengan jenis produk**, dan omnichannel bernilai hanya jika kanal-kanalnya benar-benar terhubung, bukan sekadar berjumlah banyak.
segments.tr: 3. **Distribution intensity (intensive/selective/exclusive) must match the product type**, and omnichannel is valuable only if the channels are truly connected, not just numerous.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah produsen keripik ingin produknya tersedia di sebanyak mungkin warung, minimarket, dan kantin di seluruh kota.
segments.tr: **1.** A chips manufacturer wants its product available in as many stalls, minimarkets, and canteens throughout the city as possible.

segments.src: Strategi ini disebut:
segments.tr: This strategy is called:

segments.src: - (A) Distribusi eksklusif
segments.tr: - (A) Exclusive distribution

segments.src: - (B) Distribusi selektif
segments.tr: - (B) Selective distribution

segments.src: - (C) Distribusi intensif
segments.tr: - (C) Intensive distribution

segments.src: - (D) Saluran nol tingkat
segments.tr: - (D) Zero-level channel

segments.src: **2.** Sebuah brand punya toko fisik, akun marketplace, dan aplikasi sendiri.
segments.tr: **2.** A brand has a physical store, marketplace accounts, and its own app.

segments.src: Namun stok, harga promo, dan poin member di ketiganya tidak saling terhubung.
segments.tr: However, inventory, promo prices, and member points across the three are not connected.

segments.src: Kondisi ini paling tepat disebut:
segments.tr: This condition is most accurately called:

segments.src: - (A) Omnichannel
segments.tr: - (A) Omnichannel

segments.src: - (B) Multichannel
segments.tr: - (B) Multichannel

segments.src: - (C) Distribusi eksklusif

segments.src: **3.** (Benar / Salah) Menghapus semua perantara pasti membuat total biaya distribusi menjadi lebih murah bagi produsen.
segments.tr: **3.** (True / False) Removing all intermediaries will definitely make the total distribution cost cheaper for producers.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Saluran distribusi (distribution channel):** rangkaian pihak yang membuat produk berpindah dari produsen sampai ke tangan konsumen akhir.
segments.tr: - **Distribution channel:** the network of parties that makes products move from the producer to the final consumer.

segments.src: - **Perantara (intermediary):** pihak di tengah saluran — distributor, agen, grosir, pengecer — yang menyalurkan, menyimpan, dan menanggung sebagian risiko barang.
segments.tr: - **Intermediary:** parties in the middle of the channel — distributors, agents, wholesalers, retailers — who distribute, store, and bear some of the goods' risk.

segments.src: - **Intensitas distribusi:** seberapa luas produk disebar; pilihannya intensif (sebanyak mungkin titik), selektif (beberapa terpilih), atau eksklusif (satu penyalur per wilayah).
segments.tr: - **Distribution intensity:** how widely products are spread; the choices are intensive (as many points as possible), selective (a few chosen ones), or exclusive (one dealer per region).

segments.src: - **Omnichannel:** strategi yang menyatukan seluruh kanal penjualan menjadi satu pengalaman terpadu (data pelanggan dan stok terhubung), berbeda dari multichannel yang berjalan terpisah.
segments.tr: - **Omnichannel:** a strategy that unites all sales channels into a single integrated experience (customer data and inventory connected), different from multichannel which runs separately.

segments.src: - **Last-mile:** tahap pengiriman terakhir dari titik distribusi terdekat sampai ke alamat pembeli; biasanya bagian termahal dalam rantai pengiriman.
segments.tr: - **Last-mile:** the final delivery stage from the nearest distribution point to the buyer's address; usually the most expensive part of the delivery chain.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1 — (C).
segments.tr: *Answer: 1 — (C).

segments.src: Menyebar ke sebanyak mungkin titik jual untuk barang kebutuhan sehari-hari adalah ciri distribusi intensif.
segments.tr: Spreading to as many sales points as possible for daily goods is a characteristic of intensive distribution.

segments.src: Punya banyak kanal saja belum omnichannel; tanpa integrasi stok, harga, dan data pelanggan, itu masih multichannel.
segments.tr: Having many channels alone is not yet omnichannel; without inventory, price, and customer data integration, it is still multichannel.

segments.src: 3 — Salah.
segments.tr: 3 — False.

segments.src: Perantara memang mengambil margin, tetapi mereka mengurangi jumlah jalur kontak (`3 × 5 = 15` menjadi `3 + 5 = 8`) serta menanggung stok, penyaluran, dan penagihan.
segments.tr: Intermediaries do take a margin, but they reduce the number of contact paths (`3 × 5 = 15` to become `3 + 5 = 8`) and bear inventory, distribution, and collection.

segments.src: Jika dihapus, pekerjaan itu berpindah ke produsen dan total biayanya bisa justru lebih besar.*
segments.tr: If removed, that work shifts to the producer and the total cost may actually be greater.*

id-20260912-news-1.title: 2027 State Budget Bill Officially Agreed by DPR and Government, Revenue and Expenditure Targets Rise by Rp9.1 Trillion

segments.src: Rapat Paripurna Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat (DPR) resmi menyetujui hasil pembahasan Rancangan Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (RAPBN) tahun 2027.
segments.tr: The Plenary Meeting of the House of Representatives (DPR) officially approved the results of the discussion on the 2027 State Budget Bill (RAPBN).

segments.src: Persetujuan ini merupakan hasil pembahasan bersama antara Badan Anggaran DPR dan pemerintah yang diwakili oleh Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa.
segments.tr: This approval is the result of joint discussions between the DPR Budget Committee and the government represented by Minister of Finance Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa.

segments.src: ## Poin Utama Kesepakatan
segments.tr: ## Key Points of the Agreement

segments.src: Dalam kesepakatan tersebut, target pendapatan negara dan belanja negara sama-sama dinaikkan sebesar Rp9,1 triliun dibandingkan dengan rancangan awal yang diajukan pemerintah.
segments.tr: In the agreement, both the state revenue target and state expenditure target were increased by Rp9.1 trillion compared to the initial draft submitted by the government.

segments.src: Kenaikan ini mencerminkan penyesuaian asumsi ekonomi makro serta kebutuhan pembiayaan program prioritas pemerintah untuk tahun anggaran 2027.
segments.tr: This increase reflects adjustments to macroeconomic assumptions as well as the financing needs for the government's priority programs for the 2027 fiscal year.

segments.src: Selain penyesuaian angka pendapatan dan belanja, rapat juga menetapkan sejumlah asumsi dasar ekonomi makro yang akan menjadi acuan pelaksanaan anggaran, di antaranya:
segments.tr: In addition to adjustments to revenue and expenditure figures, the meeting also established several basic macroeconomic assumptions that will serve as a reference for budget implementation, including:

segments.src: - **Pertumbuhan ekonomi** ditargetkan mencapai **6 persen**.
segments.tr: - **Economic growth** is targeted to reach **6 percent**.

segments.src: - **Inflasi** dipatok pada level **2,5 persen**.
segments.tr: - **Inflation** is pegged at the level of **2.5 percent**.

segments.src: - **Tingkat kemiskinan** ditargetkan turun ke kisaran **6,0-6,5 persen**.
segments.tr: - **The poverty rate** is targeted to drop to the range of **6.0-6.5 percent**.

segments.src: ## Proses Pembahasan di DPR
segments.tr: ## Discussion Process in the DPR

segments.src: Persetujuan RAPBN 2027 ini menjadi tahap akhir dari rangkaian panjang pembahasan antara pemerintah dan DPR yang melibatkan Komisi XI serta Badan Anggaran.
segments.tr: The approval of the 2027 State Budget Bill marks the final stage of a long series of discussions between the government and the DPR involving Commission XI and the Budget Committee.

segments.src: Sebelum dibawa ke rapat paripurna, rancangan anggaran ini telah melalui pembahasan intensif terkait postur anggaran, alokasi belanja kementerian dan lembaga, hingga proyeksi penerimaan negara dari sektor pajak, kepabeanan, dan penerimaan negara bukan pajak.
segments.tr: Before being brought to the plenary meeting, this budget draft went through intensive discussions regarding the budget posture, expenditure allocations for ministries and agencies, down to state revenue projections from the tax sector, customs, and non-tax state revenue.

segments.src: Kenaikan target pendapatan dan belanja sebesar Rp9,1 triliun disebut sebagai hasil kompromi antara optimisme pertumbuhan ekonomi dan kehati-hatian dalam menjaga keseimbangan fiskal.
segments.tr: The increase in the revenue and expenditure targets of Rp9.1 trillion is referred to as the result of a compromise between economic growth optimism and prudence in maintaining fiscal balance.

segments.src: Dengan disetujuinya RAPBN ini, pemerintah kini memiliki payung hukum untuk melanjutkan penyusunan rincian program dan kegiatan yang akan dibiayai sepanjang tahun 2027.
segments.tr: With the approval of this State Budget Bill, the government now has the legal umbrella to continue drafting the details of programs and activities to be funded throughout 2027.

segments.src: ## Target Pertumbuhan dan Tantangan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Growth Targets and Future Challenges

segments.src: Target pertumbuhan ekonomi sebesar 6 persen mencerminkan optimisme pemerintah terhadap perbaikan kinerja perekonomian nasional, meski angka tersebut lebih tinggi dibandingkan realisasi pertumbuhan pada tahun-tahun sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The economic growth target of 6 percent reflects the government's optimism regarding the improvement of national economic performance, even though this figure is higher than the growth realization in previous years.

segments.src: Untuk mencapai target tersebut, pemerintah diperkirakan akan mengandalkan sejumlah strategi, termasuk mendorong investasi, hilirisasi sumber daya alam, serta menjaga daya beli masyarakat melalui pengendalian inflasi.
segments.tr: To achieve this target, the government is expected to rely on several strategies, including promoting investment, natural resource downstreaming, and maintaining public purchasing power through inflation control.

segments.src: Sementara itu, target penurunan angka kemiskinan ke kisaran 6,0-6,5 persen menunjukkan arah kebijakan yang tetap memprioritaskan program perlindungan sosial dan pemerataan ekonomi.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, the target to reduce the poverty rate to the 6.0-6.5 percent range shows a policy direction that continues to prioritize social protection programs and economic equity.

segments.src: Pemerintah diharapkan dapat menyelaraskan alokasi belanja negara dengan program-program yang berdampak langsung terhadap kelompok masyarakat rentan.
segments.tr: The government is expected to align state expenditure allocations with programs that have a direct impact on vulnerable community groups.

segments.src: ## Langkah Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Next Steps

segments.src: Dengan disahkannya kerangka RAPBN 2027 di tingkat paripurna, tahapan selanjutnya adalah penyusunan Rancangan Undang-Undang APBN yang lebih rinci sebelum ditetapkan menjadi undang-undang.
segments.tr: With the ratification of the 2027 State Budget framework at the plenary level, the next stage is the drafting of a more detailed State Budget Law (APBN) before it is enacted into law.

segments.src: Publik dan pelaku usaha kini menantikan rincian alokasi anggaran per sektor, termasuk pos-pos belanja infrastruktur, pendidikan, kesehatan, dan subsidi, yang akan menentukan arah kebijakan fiskal pemerintah pada tahun mendatang.
segments.tr: The public and business actors are now awaiting the details of budget allocations per sector, including infrastructure, education, health, and subsidy expenditure posts, which will determine the direction of the government's fiscal policy in the coming year.

segments.src: Kesepakatan ini juga akan menjadi acuan bagi pelaku pasar dan dunia usaha dalam menyusun proyeksi bisnis, mengingat asumsi makro seperti inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi turut memengaruhi iklim investasi serta daya beli masyarakat sepanjang tahun 2027.
segments.tr: This agreement will also serve as a reference for market participants and the business world in drafting business projections, given that macro assumptions such as inflation and economic growth also influence the investment climate and public purchasing power throughout 2027.
